title: The Critical Strip
mathematical_role: Combine exact symbolic analytic geography with a finite numerical texture sampled from |zeta(s)| without converting the texture into zero evidence.
learning_objective: Locate the Riemann hypothesis in the critical strip while distinguishing exact strip landmarks from finite numerical magnitude texture.
literal_semantics: The plate uses s = sigma + it and labels real and imaginary coordinates.
The lines Re(s)=0, Re(s)=1/2, and Re(s)=1 are labelled.
The pole at s=1 is identified.
Selected trivial zeros -2 and -4 are exact symbolic landmarks.
The symmetries s <-> 1-s and s <-> conjugate(s) are annotated.
The heat field is generated from a finite grid of log10(1+|zeta(s)|) samples.
nonliteral_semantics: The finite numerical field is not a zero plot and does not certify nontrivial zero coordinates.
Sampling resolution and color mapping are rendering choices.
The displayed finite window is not a completeness claim or zero-free-region claim.

notes: The exact object is the Riemann zeta function; finite numerical samples are generated by the pinned renderer using mpmath.
Representation class changed from exact to data-derived because the corrective raster includes a numerical magnitude field.

renderer.version_or_environment: requirements/visual-pedagogy-render.txt; deterministic mpmath/Matplotlib raster renderer v4
reproducibility_notes: Finite grid and mpmath precision are fixed in the renderer.
No random seed or external service is used.
Byte-for-byte reproduction is checked in the dedicated workflow.

derivatives.role: current data-derived analytic raster review candidate; not live documentary asset

accessibility.alt_text: A numerical magnitude texture of the zeta function spans the critical strip with exact vertical landmarks at real parts zero, one-half, and one; a separate symbolic axis shows the pole and selected trivial zeros.
accessibility.long_description: The dominant panel is a finite sampled heat field of log10(1+|zeta(s)|) over sigma from -0.2 to 1.2 and t from -30 to 30. Exact strip boundaries and the critical line overlay the field. A separate lower axis carries selected exact trivial zeros and the pole. The plate explicitly states that no nontrivial zero is inferred from the heat field.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Finite reproducible numerical exposition of zeta magnitude inside exact symbolic critical-strip geography.
not_claimed: Verification of any numerical nontrivial zero

supersession_reason: Representation-layer repair adds finite source-derived analytic texture while retaining exact symbolic landmarks and an explicit non-evidence boundary.
